 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Lifestyle Lifestyle Pentagon in Manila: Ticket details for November concert 
 By GMA News Published November 2, 2026 1:34pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: Pentagon/IG Filipino Universe, rejoice! The ticketing details for K-pop group Pentagon's concert in the Philippines in November are finally here. 
 According to event promoter Show Biz (SB) Town, concert tickets range from P3,966 for general admission to P13,375 for SVIP, inclusive of ticketing charges. 
 Tickets will be on sale beginning November 7, 12 p.m. via SM Tickets. 
 Here's the full list of ticket prices. 
 Other Stories
 Pentagon is coming to Manila for November concert

 SVIP - P13,375
 VIP - P11,770
 Gold - P7,276
 General Admission - P3,966
 A slew of fan benefits awaits ticketholders. SVIP ticketholders, for one, are entitled to a set of group photocards, a hi-bye session, a group photo, soundcheck access, and an ID lanyard. Fifty SVIP ticketholders also have the chance to get a pre-signed poster. 
 Pentagon will hold its first solo concert in the country on November 29, 7 p.m., at the Aliw Theater in Pasay City. The show is part of the group's 101010 anniversary tour. 
 The group was last in the Philippines in 2022 as part of Hallyuween's concert lineup. 
 Pentagon, which debuted in 2016, was formed by Cube Entertainment through the survival show "Pentagon Maker." 
 Its current members include Jinho, Hui, Hongseok, Shinwon, Yeo One, Kino, and Wooseok. Some of its songs include "Shine," "Daisy," "Dr. BeBe," "Humph," "Naughty Boy," and more.
